mapper.select: select c.id as cartId, c.user_id as userId, c.product_id as productId, c.quantity as quantity, c.selected as selected, p.name as productName, p.cover as productCover, p.price as price, p.stock as stock, p.status as productStatus from shopping_cart c left join product p on p.id = c.product_id and p.deleted = 0 where c.user_id = #{userId} order by c.update_time desc, c.id desc
